overview: Rose Dating is a romantic dating and social app on the Internet Computer with profiles, posts, stories, direct and group chats, and a tokenized in-app economy (Rose Credits). It features a rose-themed UI with pink gradients, PWA support, and real-time social interactions.
features: User profiles with online status indicators
Direct and group messaging with emoji reactions
Posts and stories with embed support (YouTube, X, TikTok)
In-app Rose Credits economy with peer-to-peer trading
